_note: Vendored snapshot for /explore v2 Slice 4. Messier set + gallery NGC/IC designations from OpenNGC; a dozen famous non-catalogue objects carry explicit J2000 positions (see refresh-messier-catalog.mjs EXPLICIT). Each object carries a catalogue map (value, source, bibcode, record_url) from Harris, Baumgardt & Vasiliev, Hunt & Reffert, Cosmicflows-4 and SIMBAD. Refresh: node scripts/refresh-messier-catalog.mjs
